name: QuestDB
description: QuestDB is an open-source database designed to make time-series lightning fast and easy. The Web Console and REST API are on port 9000. Ingest data with the InfluxDB line protocol (9009) or over HTTP, and query it with SQL from the Web Console or any PostgreSQL client (8812). Server settings can be passed as QDB_* variables (see the configuration docs) or edited in conf/server.conf inside the data folder.
